what: NARRATION BATCH R — predictions written BEFORE each measurement, so a miss cannot be reread as a hit. One block per cluster.

clusters.id: R1 — the non-permanent forme revert is SILENT
clusters.which_scoreboard_should_move: BOTH. All three causes come from the pinned pool, so the pool must move; the lab (roster/census counts) should NOT, because no new mechanic fires — only a line stops being written.

measured.verdict: HIT at the point estimate on every clause

clusters.id: R2 — a body killed by its own thawing hit is not cured
clusters.which_scoreboard_should_move: BOTH, for the same reason as R1: three pool causes, no new mechanic. The census and roster counts should sit still.

predict.named_risk: The guard also skips the STATE change, so a corpse now leaves the field still carrying `frz` where this engine used to clear it. That is what the authority does (`cureStatus` returns before `setStatus('')`), and the probe asserts the boards on both roads — but a benched body's `status` leaf is exactly the kind of thing that could part a board somewhere the probe does not stage.

measured.verdict: HIT at the point estimate on every clause

clusters.id: R3 - an ability's clamped stat change still announces at zero
clusters.which_scoreboard_should_move: BOTH. Five pool causes, and Defiant is 17,379 sheets in the corpus so this is not an obscure-tail fix. The census and roster counts should sit still - no new mechanic fires, a line that was suppressed is written.

predict.named_risk: This ADDS lines rather than removing them, which is the direction that can unmask a later divergence in the same game. A transfer is therefore more likely here than in R1 or R2, and it would show as a new cause rather than as a board part.

measured.verdict: HIT at the point estimate on every clause

clusters.id: R5+R6 - the absorbed gift ends on switch-out, and the shield answers before the ability on the pivot road
clusters.batched_because: the two cause sets are DISJOINT (two flashfire rows, three Parting Shot rows), so a bad result is still attributable to one fix or the other.
clusters.which_scoreboard_should_move: BOTH for R6 (Parting Shot is 7,184 corpus uses and all three causes are pool cards). R5 is narrower: Flash Fire is 1,545 sheets and only the SWITCH road is in the pool, so the two pool rows should close and the lab should sit still.

predict.named_risk: R6 changes WHICH refusal is announced, and R5 ADDS a line. Both directions can unmask a later divergence in the same game, so a transfer is more likely here than in R1/R2. The shield hoist also short-circuits earlier than the ability refusal did; if any downstream state hung off the ability branch running, it would show as a board part rather than as a cause.

measured.verdict: HIT at the point estimate on every clause

note_on_the_census_digest: Every run of this batch reports census 0b88d51b3463 (830 rows, matches_live). The brief named 87d990cf3634. Same row count; the before-run and every after-run read the SAME census, so the comparison inside this batch holds.
